name: heap_sort
summary: Build a max-heap in place, then swap the root to the end and re-sift the remaining prefix.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { function siftDown(start, end) { let root = start; for (;;) { const left = 2 * root + 1; if (left > end) return; const right = left + 1; let largest = root; a.cursor('root', root); if (a.compare(largest, left) < 0) largest = left; if (right <= end && a.compare(largest, right) < 0) largest = right; if (largest === root) return; a.swap(root, largest); root = largest; } } const n = a.length; if (n < 2) { a.markSorted(); return; } for (let start = Math.floor(n / 2) - 1; start >= 0; start--) siftDown(start, n - 1); for (let end = n - 1; end >= 1; end--) { a.swap(0, end); a.mark(end, 'sorted'); siftDown(0, end - 1); } a.markSorted(); } })
